(āḥ)༄༅/ /nges nges tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs skal ldan kun/ /bzang bzang mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas mchog che/ /myur myur bgrod phyir 'pho ba'i gdams pa

tei:div.tei:p: (āḥ)༄༅// nges nges tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs skal ldan kun// bzang bzang mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas mchog che// myur myur bgrod phyir 'pho ba'i gdams pa mchog /legs legs yid bzhin nor bu'i them skas bzhugs// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra yo gi nī/ rnam dag rang bzhin don gyi dga' ma de// 'og min zhing gtso mkha' spyod dbang mo che// legs grub lhag pa'i lha la gus btud nas// bde ldan zhing du bgrod thabs zur tsam spros// zhes mchod brjod nyung ngus lam yangs por byas te/ de la 'phags yul mkhas grub kun gyi gtsug rgyan jo bo nā ro ta pa nyid la dpal ldan mkha' spyod dbang mo'i gdams pa rgya mtsho tsam bzhugs/ pham thing pa nas rim par brgyud de/ dpal ldan sa skya pa la bka' babs pa rjes 'brang mkhas grub phal gyis thos byar ma gyur pa yang zab nā ro mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba'i gdams pa 'bri ba la don gnyis te/ sbyang ba dang*/ las la sbyar ba gnyis so// dang po rang nyid sbyang ba ni bla ma tshad ldan la gdams pa legs par thob pa'i gang zag gis gnas dben par bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs sngon du 'gro ba'i skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar byas la/ rang gi smin mtshams nas khru phyed bzhi tsam spangs pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅge chen po brgyad kyi btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i gdan la ngo bo rang gi drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la rnam pa rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo gri gug dang thod khrag kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ dbu skra legs shing nu 'bur zung gis mdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po'i dbu rgyan dang do shal can gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim pas skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur/ rang nyid rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus drang po lte ba nas spyi gtsug gi bar du rtsa dbu ma chu shing gi sdong po bzhin du drang ba/ pad+ma snal ma bzhin du srab pa/ rgya skyegs kyi khu ba bzhin du dmar ba/ til mar gyi mar me bzhin du gsal ba ste chos bzhi ldan rag dung kha gyen la bslang ba lta bu'i spyi gtsug mthong bug kha yed kyis tshul du yod pas dbu ma'i nang gi lte ba'i thad du/ pha las thob pa'i dkar cha dang*/ ma las thob pa'i dmar cha sran ma kha bshags tsam gyi steng du/ rang sems kyi ngo bo bam̐ yig dmar po'i 'tsher la bkrags pa sran rdog 'bring po tsam bskal pa'i rlung gis spar spar yod pa zhig gsal btab la mdun gyi bla ma la gsol ba rtse gcig tu 'debs pa ni/ rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi rang bzhin rje// yi dam dkyil 'khor gtso dang dbyer med cing*// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo bde stsol yum// chos srung nor lha ma lus 'dus pa'i sku// kun 'dus bla ma nyid la gsol btab mthus// bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa'i// las ngan dri ma'i tshogs rnams legs sbyangs te// tshe 'di'i bdag 'dzin blo yis thongs pa dang*// dgos med las la 'gyod tshang rab skyes shing*// zab lam 'pho ba bde ldan zhing gi gnas// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su myur bgrod nas// rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs// zhes rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab pas mjug tu 'og rlung nar gyis 'then te/ hig ces drangs te phaṭa drag tu brjod pa'i rkyen gyis rnam shes kyi ngo bo bam̐ yig gyen la mda' 'phangs pa ltar song ste bla ma'i thugs khar sib kyis bstim pas brjod med du mnyam par bzhag phaṭa zhes brjod pa'i rang sems kyi bam̐ yig de nyid chu bur rdol ba bzhin du bla ma'i thugs ka nas byon rang gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs dbu ma brgyud de lte ba'i thad du sngar bzhin sleb par sems gtad la gsol 'debs re'i mjug tu phaṭa nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs brjod cing*/

thun re la gsol 'debs lan bdun la sogs bskyar zhing thun bsdu ba'i tshe bla ma rang gi spyi gtsug nas byung*/ snying ga'i thad du zhugs/ rang gi spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram dmar pos bkag par bsam/ 'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo sogs bsngo ba dang smon lam ci shes byas la thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor la mjug nas de lta bu'i nyi ma re la thun bzhi tsam re nyams su blangs la zhag bdun sogs sbyangs pa'i 'byongs rtags ni nang dri bzang gis khyab pa dang*/ sgrub khang la 'ja' zug pa dang*/ mgo bo na ba dang*/ skrangs pa dang*/ chu ser 'dzag pa dang*/ za ba sogs 'byung zhing*/ zhib pa zhal las shes so/ ༈ /gnyis pa las la sbyar ba la/ rang don dang*/ gshin don gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bde mchog sdom 'byung las/ dus thob na ni 'pho bar bya// dus min lha ni bsad par 'gyur// lha rnams bsad pa tsam gyis ni// mi ni dmyal bar mtshed par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ 'chi ltas brtags dgos/ de yi tshul la phyi nang gsang gsum las/ dang po ni phyi'i 'chi ltas ni/ dngos su rgyu rkyen med par rang gi lus yid kyi spyod pas skyo ba dang*/ gnas dang grogs la skyo ba dang*/ gshis 'gyur ba dang*/ bsam gtan 'dor ba la sogs pa 'byung zhing*// gnyis pa nang gi 'chi ltas ni/ rlung gi 'gro 'ong la brtag ste/ de yang tho rangs nas nyi shar gyi bar gyi tshes gcig gnyis gsum rnams su g.yon nas rgyu/ bzhi lnga drug la g.yas nas rgyu'o// de ltar zhag gsum gsum spel nas rgyu ba la/ brtag na go rim bzhin 'byung la/ sna bug gang rung gcig nas zhal kha yar rgyu ba la ni nyes pa med cing*/ go log nas rgyu ba nyes pa yod de zhag drug go ldog na 'thab rtsod dang sdug bsngal/ zla ba phyed du ldog na nad gdon/ zla ba gcig la nye 'brel rgud/ zla ba phyed gnyis go ldog na rang nyid zla ba drug nas 'chi bar 'gyur/ gsum pa gsang ba'i 'chi rtags la tshe gzugs brtag pa ni tho rang gi cha rang nyid gos dang bral ba'i gcer bu byas la/

nam mkha'i sprin dang bral bar bltas pa'i tshe rang gi gzugs brnyan 'char bar 'byung la/ de nyid la mgo dang yan lag sogs ma tshang na zla ba drug nas 'chi bar gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang bla ma'i zhal las 'byung ba ltar nyams su blangs te/ de ltar byung yang tshe sgrub dang dge ba'i bya ba la nan tan byas pas bzlog par 'gyur la/ gal te bzlog par ma gyur na dngos po rnams dkon mchog gi rten la mchod pa bya ba dang mgon med pa rnams la sbyin pa btang zhing*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma bzhugs na dbang bzhi rdzogs par blangs te dam tshig nyams chag bskangs/ bla ma mi bzhugs tshe/ grogs dam tshig ldan pa dang lhan du bdag 'jug blang ba sogs byas la/ nges par 'chi ba'i dus la babs na lus tsog pu'am skyil krung*/ de ltar ma grub na gzhogs g.yas 'og tu phab ste/ spyi bor bla ma bsgom pa dang rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal btab pa sogs gong bzhin byas la de nas rang gi snying gar 'od kyi gong bu dkar hril le ba zhig bsam/ de las de 'dra ba re re chad de dmyal bar skye ba'i sgo bshang lam/ dud 'gro'i sgo gci lam/ 'dod khams kyi lha'i sgo lte ba/ yi dwags kyi sgo kha/ gnod sbyin gyi sgo sna bug gnyis/ mi'i sgo mig gnyis/ mi'am ci'i sgo rna ba gnyis/ gzugs khams kyi lha'i sgo mdzod spu/ gzugs med khams kyi lha'i sgo spyi gtsug rnams rim bzhin bkag par mos la rang gi lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma bsgoms pa nas bzung gsol 'debs kyi mjug gi bar sngar ltar las/ phaṭa ces brjod pas rang sems bla ma'i thugs kar 'pho ba dang brjod med du mnyam par bzhag de'i ngang las rnam rtog skyes tshe slar yang glo bur du/ lte bar rang sems kyi ngo bo bam̐ yig gsal btab la 'pho zhing mnyam par bzhag 'jog pa las/ sbyong ba'i dus ltar rang sems phab pa'i dmigs pa sogs dmigs la de ltar bsgoms pas bar do med par zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po dang dbyer med par rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob par gyur pa nges pa'o/

༈ /gnyis pa gshin don du byed pa byung tshe/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngar bzhin byas la/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo khyod 'pho ba'i dngos gzhi nyams su blang ba ni/ sa chu la thim pa'i lus kyi yan lag rnams lci/ chu me la thim pas kha sna skam/ me rlung la thim pas mig gyen la bzlog rlung rnam par shes pa la thim pas phyi dbug chad/ rnam par shes pa 'od gsal la thim pa'i dus su dngos grub len pa'i dus yin pas/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod// ces brjod la/ de nas rang gis ji ltar bsgom pa bzhin dmigs pa rnams gsal btab/ sgom dus bla ma rang gi spyi gtsug nas gshin po phyogs pa'i rnam pa dang*/ gshin po lhar bskyed cing*/ sgo dgu bkag la de'i lus dbus su rtsa dbu ma sgom pa sogs rigs pas dpyad la nyams su blang ngo*// ༈ /de ltar zab las ches zab gsang mtha'i bcud// mkha' spyod btsun mo'i 'pho ba'i gdams pa 'di// 'di bris mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzod mdzad de// 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces mkha' spyod zhing gi gtso mo rnal 'byor ma'i zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i gdams pa zab chos 'pho ba'i man ngag 'di nyid las dang po pa rnams la phan pa'i lhag pa'i bsams pas kun nas bslangs te nyer gnas dge slong mkhyen rab 'od zer dang*/ mkhyen rab phun tshogs dang*/ mkhyen rab bsam 'grub gsum gyis nan tan chen pos yang yang bskul ba ltar/ pha bla ma rigs kun bdag po mai tri'i mtshan can dang*/ khyab bdag rdo rje sems dngos ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phun tshogs sogs yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams kyi bran du gyur pa chos tshul 'di la shes nas dad pa thob pa lha ban mkhyen brtses lcang lo can gyi bla brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mkhyen rab dar rgyas so// 'di zab chos kun gyi yang rtser gyur pa zhig yin gshis snod dang mi ldan zhing khrid ma thob pa rnams la bstan na chos bdag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis mel tshe mdzod/
gu h+ya sa ma ya/ dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
